title: c09-deep-r03
universal_lens: The universal lens unifies decision-theoretic sizing and conformal inference into a single measure-concentration framework. By treating bankroll evolution as a stochastic process, the primitives enforce distribution-free coverage guarantees (AC-RAC) while dynamically pruning actions via signal-to-noise thresholds ($\delta/\sigma$), ensuring mathematical consistency between predictive uncertainty and capital allocation.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps these operators to a hierarchical Bayesian calibration stack. The $\delta/\sigma$ gate acts as a prior predictive check, vetoing low-information regimes before generalized Kelly sizing is applied. AC-RAC provides finite-sample conformal prediction intervals, replacing flawed confidence metrics with rigorous, distribution-free probabilistic floors for every intelligence output.
gse_mapping: In GSE, this machinery governs situational state transitions. The finite-horizon binomial lattice models the 17-week season's resource constraints, while AC-RAC certifies real-time tactical adjustments. Outside-wealth inflation factors adjust stake sizing based on dynamic venue/weather causal features, translating raw statistical plumbing into auditable, in-game policy evolution.

primitives.name: Signal-to-Noise Action Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: INFERENCE: 1630's aggressiveness (.659 first-bet fraction) and the map's δ/σ gate (1748, stake only if δ_perc > 1.5σ) are complementary, not contradictory: the δ/σ gate is the filter that decides *whether* the generalized-Kelly sizing fires at all.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: $\delta_{perc}$: percentage edge estimate (dimensionless); $\sigma$: standard deviation of the edge estimate (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Edge estimates follow a stationary distribution where variance scales predictably; requires reliable historical volatility estimation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails during structural regime shifts (e.g., rule changes) where historical $\sigma$ no longer bounds current uncertainty, leading to false-positive gates.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a hypothesis testing threshold in GSI; filters out low-signal states before engaging high-variance GSE execution policies.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of filtered vs. executed actions; post-filter win rate compared to baseline.

primitives.name: Action-Conditional Risk Certificate
primitives.verbatim_quote: AC-RAC's action-conditional certificate P(u(a,Y) ≥ ν(X) | a(X)=a) ≥ 1-α does what confidence was supposed to do — it's a per-action floor with a distribution-free guarantee rather than a point estimate of win probability.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: $u(a,Y)$: utility of action $a$ given outcome $Y$ (dimensionless); $\nu(X)$: minimum acceptable utility floor conditioned on features $X$ (dimensionless); $\alpha$: significance level (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Exchangeability of the data sequence; the utility function $u$ accurately reflects the true economic payoff structure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down under severe non-stationarity or adversarial data generation where exchangeability is violated, invalidating the $1-\alpha$ coverage guarantee.

layer2.mapping: Derives a hard constraint kernel for GSE policy networks, ensuring no action is taken unless the conformal lower bound exceeds the ruin threshold.
layer2.telemetry: Empirical violation rate of the utility floor over a rolling window of 100 actions.

primitives.name: Seasonal Resource Lattice
primitives.verbatim_quote: map's Kelly chain (0813/0834/1748/1222).** New content: finite-horizon binomial lattice for the 17-week season and the (1+w/g) outside-reserves inflation factor — neither appears elsewhere in the slice.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: $w$: current wealth (currency units); $g$: growth target or base unit (currency units); time steps $t \in \{1, ..., 17\}$ (weeks).
primitives.assumptions: Discrete weekly compounding; outside reserves scale linearly with internal wealth dynamics without external shocks.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities arise if $g \to 0$ or if catastrophic drawdowns force early termination of the 17-week horizon, breaking the lattice boundary conditions.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSE's temporal planning horizon, discretizing continuous bankroll management into auditable weekly state transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Deviation of actual end-of-season wealth from the lattice-predicted median path.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core mathematical derivation stems from the failure of traditional confidence metrics (resolution ≈ 0) to provide actionable risk bounds. We replace point-estimate confidence with a dual-layer operator: the $\delta/\sigma$ gate acts as a preliminary variance filter, mathematically equivalent to rejecting the null hypothesis of zero edge at a strict significance level. Only upon passing this gate does the system engage the generalized Kelly sizing, which optimizes logarithmic utility over a finite 17-week binomial lattice. Crucially, the AC-RAC primitive introduces a distribution-free safety net. By framing the problem through conformal inference, we derive a certificate $P(u(a,Y) \geq \nu(X) \mid a(X)=a) \geq 1-\alpha$. This transforms the stochastic control problem into a constrained optimization where the constraint is the conformal lower bound. The duality lies in balancing the aggressive growth of the Kelly fraction against the conservative, worst-case guarantees of AC-RAC. Failure modes emerge when the underlying data generating process (DGP) shifts, causing the historical $\sigma$ to underestimate true volatility, thereby allowing the gate to pass suboptimal actions that subsequently violate the AC-RAC floor, leading to compounded drawdowns.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This lineage traces back to Wald's sequential analysis and Kelly's log-optimal portfolio theory, but pivots sharply with Vovk's game-theoretic probability and Romano's conformal inference. The integration of minimax weighted regret (MWER) remedies addresses the dynamic inconsistency inherent in naive Kelly betting under non-stationary DGPs, creating a modern, auditable decision-theoretic stack. reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the opposing agent (the market or sportsbook) as an adaptive entity that exploits overconfident predictors. By recognizing that traditional confidence scores are easily gamed or miscalibrated, our system adopts a defensive posture. The AC-RAC certificate assumes the adversary can manipulate point estimates, forcing us to rely solely on distribution-free, worst-case utility floors to protect capital against strategic exploitation.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A strict anti-collinearity veto is enforced between the $\delta/\sigma$ gate and the AC-RAC certificate. If the gate's signal-to-noise metric becomes highly correlated with the conformal residual width, it indicates leakage or double-counting of uncertainty. Furthermore, any action where the outside-wealth inflation factor pushes the effective stake beyond the lattice's maximum sustainable growth rate is immediately vetoed to prevent ruin-machine dynamics.
